title: ShardTests.test_no_shard_runs_all fails on a thread-order race; make the order fixed
why: Real incident: lane stood-pick-closes-on-answer (PR 3171): `merge --lane-lint` failed twice at 618378bdc on hooks/test_mutate_shared.py ShardTests.test_no_shard_runs_all (got [a,c,b], expected [a,b,c]); on main fccff95e6 it failed 2 of 30 runs on 4 CPUs.
note: Todo, new lane (build; test-author, builder, reviewer). Cause (lane read): run_mutants runs mutants in a pool sized job_count() (MUTATE_JOBS, else CPU count), so the `ran` order is a thread race and the test expects abc. Fix choices: the test compares sorted, or run_shard sets MUTATE_JOBS=1, or run_mutants orders its result. Pick the one that keeps the production order meaningful; do not weaken the test. The flake blocks lane lint on unrelated PRs, so a real debt: a lane hits it in normal work. Recurrence, 12:46 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 12:46 CST): lane record-claim-cites-code (#3182): first lane-lint run failed on the mutation fixture suite, the rerun passed. Second lane to hit it (first: stood-pick-closes-on-answer, #3171).
